units.source_text: 释迦对众生说：要解脱轮回转世的羁绊，得作涅檠铁心修行。

en.t: Shakyamuni told all living beings: to free oneself from the bonds of reincarnation, one must practice with an iron will toward nirvana.

units.source_text: 灵魂必须来回转世，它可能是迷惘而可怜的。

en.t: The soul must pass again and again through rebirth; perhaps it is bewildered and pitiable.

units.source_text: 但我觉得，在这个世界上，再没有什么比轮回转世的教诲交织出的童话故事般的梦境更丰富多彩的了。

en.t: But I feel that in this world, nothing is richer or more varied than the fairy-tale dream woven by the teaching of reincarnation.

units.source_text: 这是人类创造的最美的爱的抒情诗。

en.t: This is the most beautiful lyric poem of love that humanity has created.

units.source_text: 在印度，自《吠陀经》以来就存在这个信仰，这可能本来就是东方的精神。

en.t: In India, this belief has existed since the Vedas; perhaps it was originally the very spirit of the East.

units.source_text: 不过，在希腊的神话中，也有明朗的花的故事，

en.t: Even so, in Greek mythology too there are bright stories of flowers,

units.source_text: 包括《浮士德》中格蕾琴的牢狱之歌在内，

en.t: including Gretchen's prison song in Faust,

units.source_text: 西方有关向动植物转世的传说，真是多如星辰。

en.t: and in the West, legends of rebirth into animals and plants are truly as countless as the stars.
